read_parquet: read a parquet file into a DataFrame with optional column selection and row limiting
scan_parquet: lazily scan a local or cloud parquet file or glob pattern returning a LazyFrame for optimized queries
read_parquet_schema: get the schema of a parquet file as a dictionary mapping column names to data types without reading data
read_parquet_metadata: get file-level custom metadata of a parquet file without reading the actual data
read_parquet_with_pyarrow: read parquet files using the PyArrow backend with optional memory mapping and rechunking
